I've reviewed the publisher's current license, and it requires the district to provide one individually assigned digital account per student and one authorized print copy per student. The license does permit 96 print copies for this cohort, but it does not permit shared classroom-code access. The draft plan's proposal of 80 printed copies and shared classroom-code digital access would put us out of compliance with the license terms.
